subject: Cross-region traffic & data residency — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Elina Korhonen <elina.korhonen@novabank.fi>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Follow-up: Cross-region traffic & residency from today's call

Hi Elina,

Thanks for the call earlier — good clarity on NovaBank's EU-first requirements. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can scope the right deployment option (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):

- Options we discussed:
  * Hosted API (EU region): model serving and data-at-rest in EU region; traffic may traverse regional edges for caching and CDN. Good for fast time-to-value.
  * Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs in EU): predictable throughput, customer-isolated pools in eu-west1, can restrict egress to EU-only networking.
  * Private (VPC/on-prem): full customer network control, optional on-prem package for stricter sovereignty.

Clarification points (helps us pick a recommended path):
1) Data residency: Must all inference request payloads, logs, and cached KV data remain physically within EU (yes/no)?
2) Cross-border auth or control plane: Any admin access/users located outside EU who require live access? If so, which regions?
3) Traffic profile: peak rps, avg request size, and latency SLO (p95) you expect.
4) Key management: need for customer-managed KMS/HSM in EU?
5) Procurement timeline and cross-team stakeholders (security, infra, procurement): target dates?

I've attached a short options brief and our SOC2 summary for reference. Next steps: if residency must be strict EU-only, we'll prioritize Private VPC or Dedicated with EU-only egress; propose a security deep-dive this week to validate network controls.

Proposed next actions:
- Security deep-dive (45m) — coordinate with your InfoSec and our SRE
- Draft mutual action plan (M.A.P) with milestones for PoC and procurement
- Share a short questionnaire on model/PKI update cadence for patching

Thanks — ping me times that work for the deep-dive and any immediate answers to the bullets above.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference
attachments: regional-deployment-options.pdf (pdf), SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Elina Korhonen <elina.korhonen@novabank.fi>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sven Berg <sven.berg@novabank.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:38:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Cross-region traffic & residency from today's call

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline:

1) Data residency: Yes — all request payloads, logs, and any cached artifacts must remain within EU physical infrastructure. No copies in APAC/US.
2) Cross-border admin: A small set of global ops (in London and Frankfurt) may need access; no admins outside EU/UK.
3) Traffic: Start modest — ~30 rps peak during morning batch windows, expected growth to 200 rps within 6 months. Typical request ~2–3KB.
4) KMS: We require customer-managed keys with EU KMS (preferred vendor: Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS EU regions). HSM preferred for encryption-at-rest of sensitive models.
5) Timeline: Security signoff by end of Q2; PoC in Q3 if procurement clears. Stakeholders: info-sec (me), cloud infra (Sven Berg), procurement (Helena).

Preference: Private VPC would be ideal (full network control). However, if Redwood can guarantee Dedicated EU-only capacity with KMS in EU and no cross-region KV replication, we're open to evaluating Dedicated as a faster PoC path.

Please send a proposed MAP and available times for a security deep-dive. Also include a brief on how model updates and KV cache replication are handled.

Thanks,
Elina Korhonen
Head of Cloud & Data Security
NovaBank
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:55:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Follow-up: Cross-region traffic & residency from today's call

Ben / Marissa — quick notes from Elina's answers:
- EU-only residency hard requirement; KMS/HSM required in EU.
- Preference for Private VPC but open to Dedicated if we can commit to EU-only egress and no KV replication to other regions.
- Traffic profile small now, but growth to 200 rps in 6 months — doable with Dedicated but we need sizing.

My recommendation:
1) Draft a two-track MAP: (A) Dedicated EU-only pilot (fastest), (B) Private VPC plan (longer procurement). Include clear acceptance criteria for residency and KMS.
2) SRE/infra to validate that our Dedicated pools can be configured to prevent cross-region KV replication and to use customer-managed KMS in EU (raise infra ticket).
3) Prepare a short doc on our update/patch cadence for models and KV cache replication flows for the security deep-dive.

I'll start a MAP draft and pull in SRE. Ben, can you schedule the security deep-dive for Wed/Thu EU morning? Marissa — can you prepare the model-update/KV flow doc and a quick sizing note for Dedicated at 200 rps?

Karthik
Director, Solutions
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Elina Korhonen <elina.korhonen@novabank.fi>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-25T16:12:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Cross-region traffic & residency from today's call

Hi Elina — thanks for the clarity.

Quick next steps from our side:
- We've attached an initial MAP draft and a short mapping sheet to capture stakeholders and timelines.
- We'll propose a security deep-dive on Thursday 2027-04-29 at 10:00 CET; please confirm or propose an alternative.
- I'll include a concise note on model update cadence, KV cache behavior, and where/when replicas are created — we will ensure no KV replication outside EU for Dedicated and Private.

Attachments: novabank-mapping-sheet.xlsx (xls), m-a-plan-draft.docx (docx)

If Private VPC is the end state, we'll outline steps and estimated timeline for procurement + on-prem options; if Dedicated is chosen first, we'll include tech constraints to guarantee EU-only residency.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference
